0022600189.text: The Pacers (3-6, 10th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central) face the Nuggets (4-3, 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest) in this regular-season game at a neutral site in Mexico City, Indiana's 10th game of the season. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton, Kelly Oubre Jr., Ben Sheppard, Johnny Furphy and T.J. McConnell, while Denver is without DeMar DeRozan, Julian Strawther and Spencer Jones. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in their last meeting Denver beat Indiana 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025, part of a 2025-26 season series in which the Pacers lost 0-2.
